title: Contain reclaimed worker processes when abort scheduling fails
summary: Make reclaimed-job abort delivery return containment status, invoke the backend-owned tracked process-tree abort synchronously when callback scheduling fails, and keep retrying until exit is accepted or proven.
reason: Remediate P1 AUDIT-FIND-W01-025. The worker previously stopped heartbeats after a best-effort abort callback even when the scheduler dropped that callback, allowing the reclaimed encode process to keep writing while the coordinator could redispatch the source.
behavior_before: Reclaim and heartbeat-outage branches scheduled an abort callback and broke out of the heartbeat loop unconditionally. Scheduler failure was only logged; no owned direct kill, exit check, or retry remained active.
behavior_after: Abort dispatch returns a containment result. Scheduler failure invokes the backend application's owned active-process abort directly, exit is checked with the existing bounded waiter, and unproven/failed containment leaves the heartbeat controller alive to retry instead of silently abandoning the process.
tests_added: tests/python/desktop/test_network_protocol_runtime.py: scheduler failure invokes owned direct containment and reports success only after bounded exit verification.
tests/python/desktop/test_network_protocol_runtime.py: direct kill failure returns uncontained with actionable diagnostics.
tests/python/desktop/test_network_protocol_runtime.py: reclaimed heartbeat retries abort delivery until containment is accepted.
